segments.source: Provides the delegate a captured image in RAW format.
segments.ko: delegate에 RAW 형식의 캡처된 이미지를 제공합니다.

segments.source: **Availability**:
segments.ko: **Availability**:

segments.source: iPadOS 10.0+
segments.ko: iPadOS 10.0+

segments.source: Discussion
segments.ko: Discussion

segments.source: Use this method to receive the results of a RAW format capture.
segments.ko: 이 메서드를 사용해 RAW 형식 캡처의 결과를 받습니다.

segments.source: (If you request capture in both RAW and a processed format, the photo output calls both this method and the [`photoOutput(_:didFinishProcessingPhoto:previewPhoto:resolvedSettings:bracketSettings:error:)`](avcapturephotocapturedelegate/photooutput(_:didfinishprocessingphoto:previewphoto:resolvedsettings:bracketsettings:error:).md) method.)
segments.ko: (RAW와 처리 형식으로 모두 캡처를 요청하면 photo output이 이 메서드와 [`photoOutput(_:didFinishProcessingPhoto:previewPhoto:resolvedSettings:bracketSettings:error:)`](avcapturephotocapturedelegate/photooutput(_:didfinishprocessingphoto:previewphoto:resolvedsettings:bracketsettings:error:).md) 메서드를 모두 호출합니다.)

segments.source: ❗ **Important**: You must implement either this method or the [`photoOutput(_:didFinishProcessingPhoto:error:)`](avcapturephotocapturedelegate/photooutput(_:didfinishprocessingphoto:error:).md) method if you request capture in a RAW format.
segments.ko: ❗ **중요**: RAW 형식으로 캡처를 요청하는 경우 이 메서드 또는 [`photoOutput(_:didFinishProcessingPhoto:error:)`](avcapturephotocapturedelegate/photooutput(_:didfinishprocessingphoto:error:).md) 메서드 중 하나를 구현해야 합니다.

segments.source: The photo output validates this requirement when you call its [`capturePhoto(with:delegate:)`](avcapturephotooutput/capturephoto(with:delegate:).md) method; if your delegate does not implement the correct methods, the photo output raises an exception.
segments.ko: photo output은 [`capturePhoto(with:delegate:)`](avcapturephotooutput/capturephoto(with:delegate:).md) 메서드를 호출할 때 이 요구 사항을 검증하며, delegate가 올바른 메서드를 구현하지 않은 경우 photo output이 예외를 발생시킵니다.

segments.source: If you request RAW format capture, the photo output calls this method once for each exposure in the capture request.
segments.ko: RAW 형식 캡처를 요청하면 photo output은 캡처 요청의 각 노출마다 이 메서드를 한 번씩 호출합니다.

segments.source: If you request a single image capture, this method is called once.
segments.ko: 단일 이미지 캡처를 요청하면 이 메서드는 한 번 호출됩니다.

segments.source: If you request a bracketed capture with multiple exposures, this method is called once for each exposure.
segments.ko: If you request a bracketed capture with multiple exposures, this method is called once for each exposure.

segments.source: Parameters
segments.ko: Parameters

segments.source: `output`: The photo output performing the capture.
segments.ko: `output`: The photo output performing the capture.

segments.source: `rawSampleBuffer`: A sample buffer containing the captured RAW image. The format of this buffer matches the format you requested for the RAW image (see the [`rawPhotoPixelFormatType`](avcapturephotosettings/rawphotopixelformattype.md) property of your photo settings). If an error prevented successful capture, this parameter is `nil`—see the `error` parameter for a description of the failure.
segments.ko: `rawSampleBuffer`: A sample buffer containing the captured RAW image. The format of this buffer matches the format you requested for the RAW image (see the [`rawPhotoPixelFormatType`](avcapturephotosettings/rawphotopixelformattype.md) property of your photo settings). If an error prevented successful capture, this parameter is `nil`—see the `error` parameter for a description of the failure.

segments.source: `previewPhotoSampleBuffer`: If you requested a thumbnail-sized version of the photo (with the [`previewPhotoFormat`](avcapturephotosettings/previewphotoformat.md) property of your photo settings object), a sample buffer containing the thumbnail photo in the requested format. If you did not request preview delivery, or if an error prevented capture, this parameter is `nil`.
segments.ko: `previewPhotoSampleBuffer`: If you requested a thumbnail-sized version of the photo (with the [`previewPhotoFormat`](avcapturephotosettings/previewphotoformat.md) property of your photo settings object), a sample buffer containing the thumbnail photo in the requested format. If you did not request preview delivery, or if an error prevented capture, this parameter is `nil`.

segments.source: `resolvedSettings`: An object describing the settings used for this capture. Match this object’s [`uniqueID`](avcapturephotosettings/uniqueid.md) value to the [`uniqueID`](avcapturephotosettings/uniqueid.md) property of the photo settings object you initiated capture with to determine which capture request this delegate call corresponds to. You can also use this object to find out which values the photo output has chosen for automatic settings.
segments.ko: `resolvedSettings`: An object describing the settings used for this capture. Match this object’s [`uniqueID`](avcapturephotosettings/uniqueid.md) value to the [`uniqueID`](avcapturephotosettings/uniqueid.md) property of the photo settings object you initiated capture with to determine which capture request this delegate call corresponds to. You can also use this object to find out which values the photo output has chosen for automatic settings.

segments.source: `bracketSettings`: If you requested a bracketed capture of multiple images with a [`AVCapturePhotoBracketSettings`](avcapturephotobracketsettings.md), a bracketed still image settings object describing which image in the bracket this delegate call corresponds to. If you did not request bracketed capture, this parameter is `nil`.
segments.ko: `bracketSettings`: If you requested a bracketed capture of multiple images with a [`AVCapturePhotoBracketSettings`](avcapturephotobracketsettings.md), a bracketed still image settings object describing which image in the bracket this delegate call corresponds to. If you did not request bracketed capture, this parameter is `nil`.

segments.source: `error`: If an the capture process could not proceed successfully, an error object describing the failure; otherwise, `nil`.
segments.ko: `error`: If an the capture process could not proceed successfully, an error object describing the failure; otherwise, `nil`.
